sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Fall in love with the Heart Solitaire CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women. This stunning ring features a sparkling heart-shaped CZ stone set atop an elegant crossover gold-plated band, accentuated with pavé CZ for extra brilliance. Delightfully romantic, the Heart Solitaire CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women is the perfect expression of affection for daily wear, special occasions, or as a thoughtful gift.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Timeless heart-shaped solitaire for love and elegance
✨ Crossover band with added pavé sparkle
✨ Adjustable fit for everyday comfort
✨ Ideal for daily wear, date nights, or gifting someone special
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Durable premium-quality alloy
🔹 Plating: Luxurious gold plating for rich shine
🔹 Stone Type: Heart-shaped and round pavé cubic zirconia
🔹 Design: Elegant crossover band with heart solitaire
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable to suit most finger sizes comfortably
🔹 Best Use: Perfect for daily wear, party wear, romantic gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
